annotations.title: NIS2: official list of entity types

description: Official list of the entity types in annexes I–IV of Italian D.Lgs. 4 settembre 2024 n. 138 (NIS2 transposition), verbatim from the Gazzetta Ufficiale text (in Italian), with text search. Use it to find the `tipologia_id` to pass to `nis2_ambito`. ⚠️ There is NO ATECO code → entity type map, and this tool does not use one: the declaration on the ACN platform (art. 11 c. 2 of ACN determination 314287/2026) keeps ATECO codes and entity types SEPARATE, and scope is determined by the ENTITY TYPE, defined by reference to an EU rule. Inferring NIS2 scope from an ATECO code means applying a rule the source does not contain. Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

allegato.description: Filter by annex. I = sectors of high criticality (51 types); II = other critical sectors (15); III = public administrations (15); IV = further types, in scope only if identified by the ACN (4).

q.description: Text search over entity type text, sector and subsector, in Italian (accents and case ignored; all terms must appear). E.g. 'cloud', 'energia elettrica', 'rifiuti'. Empty = the whole catalogue.

query.description: Alias of `q` (search text): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.
